parts:
Hi Philip,

Can you provide a bit of background as to why you are creating your own mappability file?  What is the bin/window size that you want to use?  If it's 1kb (1000bp), then these files are already provided in the TITANRunner download for hg19.  

If you are creating your own file, then can you please show me the commands you are using so I can help with your issue?  Can you show also me a small exert of the content in your current mappability?

Your command should look something like this for, let's say, 100kb bins.
./mapCounter -w 100000 -c chr1,chr2,chr3,chr4,chr5,chr6,chr7,chr8,chr9,chr10,chr11,chr12,chr13,chr14,chr15,chr16,chr17,chr18,chr19,chr20,chr21,chr22,chrX,chrY wgEncodeCrgMapabilityAlign100mer.bigWig > map_hg19_100kb.wig

Notice that wgEncodeCrgMapabilityAlign100mer.bigWig was downloaded from UCSC (http://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/goldenpath/hg19/encodeDCC/wgEncodeMapability/).
The downloaded mappability file uses "chr" for their chromosome names so usually removed them, but this is not necessary. 

Best,
Gavin

messages.subject: Re: titan_correctreads.sh error
parts:
Hi Philip,

I was unaware that you are working with the mouse genome.  Again, it would be really helpful if you provided some code so I can figure out what you're doing.

If you wanted to create the mappability scores from scratch, you would use generateMap.pl, followed by mapCounter.  Remember, TitanCNA accepts a wig file that is output by mapCounter  not a bw file that is output from the intermediate step by generateMap.pl. There are 2 steps to generating the proper input to TitanCNA or correctReads.R

util/mappability/generateMap.pl > mappability.bw  #first step
bin/mapCounter mappability.bw > map.wig  #second step
# map.wig is the input used by TitanCNA, not mappability.bw

You could also skip the generateMap.pl step by searching for the mappability scores on UCSC.  This is what I was able to find:
http://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/gbdb/mm9/bbi/crgMapabilityAlign100mer.bw

If this is the correct file for your needs, then you can use this file in mapCounter.  

bin/mapCounter crgMapabilityAlign100mer.bw > map.wig

Hope this helps,
Gavin

messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: titan_correctreads.sh error
parts:
Hi Philip,

The index (.idx) and tabix (.tabix) are 2 different types of indices.  The .idx file is used for unzipped vcf files whereas .tabix is used for gzipped files. The way the TITANRunner pipeline and filterCounters.py is implemented, you need to provide a vcf.gz file and a .tabix index.

You can follow the instructions on the samtools webpage to generate both if your VCF (i.e. dbSNP, HapMap, 1KG, etc) is not currently zipped. 
I think for .tabix to work, your vcf needs to be compressed using bgzip.

Hope this helps,
Gavin
